drafted_from: tool:turn-frames-into-slides-from-a-request's row in tools/turn-frames-into-slides/what-this-tool-does-and-how-to-run-it.json and the made-up board of test/make-slides.test.mjs (the same program, make-slides.mjs, run by the engine with the request given inline)
start_here: Say to your AI: "Make slides from my deck: two frames, the first saying Made for Example Co and its 70 people., the second One line. and A second line., on paper #f5f1ea in ink #202020 with Georgia and Helvetica, titled Example deck." It calls tool:turn-frames-into-slides-from-a-request with that request as JSON and gives you the kept slides.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list: it reads one request given as JSON and keeps the slide files it writes in the person's files.
instructions: 1. Have the board's items (a presentation frame is an item with extra.presentationFrame.order; every item centred inside it is on that slide), or the deck as slides, and your look's values from tool:resolve-a-look.

2. Call tool:turn-frames-into-slides-from-a-request with input {request: {board: {items: [...]}, title, look_values: {palette: {...}}, assets?: {name: https address}, frames?, words_from?, words_rules?}}. Everything is given inline: no file of yours is read.
3. Read the answer: result.slides (order, label, number of items, svg) and result.html, and files.slides, each written file kept in your files under Made by tools with its identity.
4. Open the kept SVGs or deck.html and look at every page: text cut short ends in an ellipsis, so give that item more room.
5. For a PDF or a picture of every page, run tool:turn-frames-into-slides on your own computer with a Chromium; this one makes none.
6. If the run stops, its words say what to change: a look variable the look lacks, an unknown asset, a frame name that is not a frame, frames of different sizes or words a rule refuses.

worked_examples.title: Two frames become two kept slides
worked_examples.ask: Make slides from my two frames.

items.text: Made for Example Co and its 70 people.

worked_examples.given: The made-up board of test/make-slides.test.mjs without its file asset, given inline; the look names its fonts (--font-display, --font-primary), which every request's look must. Run for real through make-slides.mjs at 5:4x PM CST Nov 21 2026 in the row's own layout.
worked_examples.hands_back: result.slides [{order 1, label Slide 1, items 1}, {order 2, label Slide 2, items 1}], result.html, and files.slides: slides/01.svg, slides/02.svg and deck.html, each with its identity and its name under /Made by tools/Turn frames into slides from a request/.

worked_examples.title: A name that is not a frame stops the run
worked_examples.given: The same request with frames: ["second-body"], which is a text item, not a frame.
worked_examples.hands_back: The run fails with exit 2 and nothing is kept; its words: "make-slides: frames names second-body, which is not a frame on the board."
